benchmark: historical author B=0.1. Not B_cri. The Binder source gate stands.
hamiltonian: sum_{i<j} J_ij Z_i Z_j + 0.1 sum_i X_i, J iid Normal(0,1), SeedSequence([20261115, N, k])
k_not_used: 0..177 were used in earlier rounds; 190 and above stay unused. k=100 and k=101 stay held out.
forbidden: any family whose parameter count is not 1+3L, 2+3L, 3+3L, or 2L

families.nodata: shared gamma, interleaved packing, 1+3L, seed provider
families.K: shared gamma, interleaved packing, 2+3L, seed provider
families.KM: shared-gamma reference, interleaved packing, 3+3L. Not the claim.
families.nodata_fe: shared gamma on the ferromagnetic triples, seed provider
families.K_fe: shared gamma on those triples, seed provider
families.KM_fe: shared gamma, thetaK, thetaM, three shell angles per layer, ferromagnetic triple partition. 3+3L. Same UcX at every layer. The claim.
families.qaoa: independent gamma_l and beta_l, 2L, round-4 standard budget, equal depth

packing_rule: exact maximization of the sum of -J_ij over the three edges of each triple, partition of all sites, lexicographically smallest sorted partition on ties. Classical J only. The same partition is used at every layer and every N. M is the original block-mean construction on that partition. K is J@J and does not depend on the partition. Popcount shells are rebuilt on the same triples.
architecture: cavity X frame, start |+> in the logical simulator which is |0>^N then W, repeat UcX = W D W then popcount shellSNAP, final W included in the logical trailing transform. One gamma, one thetaK, one thetaM for all layers. Exactly three shell angles per layer, shared by the cavities.
box: every linear coefficient and each QAOA gamma in [-2pi/s_J, 2pi/s_J]; shells and beta in [-2pi, 2pi]

seeds.note: Same integer prefixes as round 4. The instance index k is inside every seed, and k=178..189 were not fit before.

continuation: KM and KM_fe: Zhou interpolation of the shells with the shared coefficients kept, time-rescaled coefficients times (L-1)/L, perturbations N(0,0.1) and N(0,0.3), two ramps, nested seed from K or K_fe. QAOA: Zhou interpolation, append-zero, perturbations, two ramps, and the best append-zero plus N(0,0.05).
selection: lowest energy within a repeat; the reported state is the lower of the two repeats. No ground state, eigenvector, E0, or fidelity in packing, features, starts, beam, or selection.
primary_metric: F_sub within 1e-6 of E0, all N, computed after selection on the energy-selected state

confirmation.equal_search: each family uses the round-4 start list: L=1 grid top 4, the L1_random counts, beam 3, and the continuation maps. KM_fe does not receive extra starts.
confirmation.pass_at_N: wins > losses, and the bootstrap 95 percent interval for the median fidelity difference has lower endpoint > 0
confirmation.overall_partial: N=6 passes and at least one of N=9 or N=12 does not
confirmation.overall_incomplete: any N has fewer than 8 complete instances
confirmation.energy_drop_rule: E of interleaved KM minus E of KM_fe at L=6. Descriptive. A drop above 0.01 on at least four instances, or a median above 0.01, means the ferromagnetic packing lowered the energy relative to interleaved. It is not a second win rule.
confirmation.reading_if_no_drop: The ferromagnetic packing did not lower the KM energy under the frozen 0.01 rule. A pass against QAOA on this sample is the shared-gamma search, not a packing gain.
confirmation.reading_if_drop: The ferromagnetic packing lowered the KM energy under the frozen 0.01 rule. The QAOA comparison is still the verdict.

secondary_equal_param.role: reported only, not part of the verdict

job_order: k ascending, within k N=12 then 9 then 6, repeats inner
